# EDUCAbase income fixtures

These are full official CSV and PC-Axis responses captured on 2026-08-09 for
deterministic parser and reconciliation tests. Their byte lengths, SHA-256
hashes, declared content types, and decoding contracts are recorded in
`source-evidence.json`.

Production refreshes download the current official artifacts and do not pin
their hashes to this fixture evidence. Updating a fixture requires a newly
reviewed evidence record before the capture script can write it.
